summaries.ai_data: AI Data Specialist with four years of experience training and evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) at Snorkel AI, RWS / Meta AI, Outlier and Remotask. Delivers expert-level code evaluation, mathematical reasoning, engineering content, prompt engineering and multimodal annotation (text, video, image, 3D / LiDAR), consistently ranking among high-performing contributors. Combines a BSc in Mechanical Engineering with software engineering practice, now as a Backend and Systems Integration Engineer at talQen, so can judge technical correctness as well as guideline compliance. Strong on annotation consistency, Quality Assurance (QA) and mentoring annotators across high-volume pipelines.
summaries.software: Software Engineer specializing in backend development and systems integration, currently building microservices and ASTM E1394 / Health Level Seven (HL7) v2 analyzer drivers at talQen. Previously a Full-Stack and Oracle Developer at Radia Pearlman Technologies, delivering Python, Node.js and Oracle Procedural Language/SQL (PL/SQL) solutions, NewGen Business Process Management (BPM) workflow automation and Representational State Transfer (REST) Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) for enterprise clients. Holds a Software Engineering (Backend Specialty) certification from ALX Africa – Holberton and a BSc in Mechanical Engineering, with experience in Agile teams, SQL performance tuning, networking, data analysis and clear technical documentation. Also has four years of experience evaluating and creating code and STEM content for AI model training.
summaries.mechanical: Mechanical Engineer with a Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Nairobi and registered membership of the Engineers Board of Kenya (EBK). Experienced in Computer-Aided Design (CAD) modelling with AutoCAD and SolidWorks, Finite Element Analysis (FEA), structural design, preventive maintenance and root-cause troubleshooting from a mechanical engineering internship at Numerical Machining Complex, and from an electric vehicle dashboard capstone. Produces clear engineering reports and technical documentation. Adds Python, Structured Query Language (SQL) and laboratory instrument-integration skills from current engineering work at talQen, and has contributed mechanical analysis, thermodynamics and structural problem content to AI model training.
summaries.general: Mechanical and Software Engineer and AI Data Specialist with a Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Nairobi and registered membership of the Engineers Board of Kenya (EBK). Currently builds backend microservices and ASTM E1394 / Health Level Seven (HL7) v2 analyzer integrations at talQen, with four years of experience training and evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs), prior Oracle and full-stack development experience at Radia Pearlman Technologies, and Computer-Aided Design (CAD) and Finite Element Analysis (FEA) skills from a mechanical engineering internship.

bullets.text: Enabled bidirectional data flow between three clinical analyzer models (HumaCount 5D, HumaStar 100, SweeLab) and host Laboratory Information System (LIS) applications by engineering ASTM E1394 and Health Level Seven (HL7) v2 communication drivers.

Developed backend microservices for a continuous laboratory Quality Management System (QMS) platform aligned with ISO 15189:2022 and Kenya Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC) regulations.
Automated Quality Control (QC) monitoring by designing data ingestion modules that parse real-time analyzer output and trigger statistical alerts based on Westgard rules.

Onboarded pilot medical laboratories on-site and remotely by configuring static IP subnets, switch routing, TCP listener ports and local firewall rules, ensuring dual-path internet and device connectivity.
Restored stable multi-analyzer connectivity by resolving cryptographic token, sender key and network socket reconnection issues in bridging middleware.
Aligned generative AI models with audio and contextual cues by performing video and text annotation and pairwise evaluations of avatar behaviors for Meta AI research.
Maintained annotation consistency and accuracy across high-volume pipelines by following detailed project guidelines.
Improved training data quality for large-scale generative AI models by refining annotation standards with global teams while managing several concurrent projects.

Improved Large Language Model (LLM) code-generation accuracy across technical domains by evaluating and ranking AI-generated Python, SQL and algorithm outputs for correctness, efficiency and best practice.

Strengthened Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM) reasoning in frontier models by delivering advanced mathematics and engineering content, including mechanical analysis, thermodynamics and structural problems.
Scaled training-data quality for production AI systems by contributing to data programming workflows with Snorkel labeling functions and programmatic supervision.
Provided high-quality Python, SQL and algorithm solutions to train and evaluate large-scale AI code-generation models.

Led backend engineering across multiple enterprise projects by building and maintaining server-side systems in Python (Django, Flask) and Node.js (Express) covering business logic, authentication, session management and database integration.
Maintained data integrity and performance by designing and maintaining Oracle database schemas with referential integrity, normalization and optimal indexing.
Automated enterprise data pipelines and enforced business rules by designing Oracle schemas and Procedural Language/SQL (PL/SQL) stored procedures, functions, triggers and packages.

Cut critical query response times by up to 40% on high-volume datasets by optimizing Structured Query Language (SQL) with EXPLAIN PLAN, SQL Trace and DBMS_STATS; reduced one reporting query from 8 seconds to under 1 second through index redesign and BULK COLLECT / FORALL.

Enabled front-end and third-party integrations by designing, building and documenting RESTful APIs with OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, and delivered responsive React and MERN web applications for data-intensive enterprise clients.

Reduced a client's document approval cycle by 60% (5 manual steps to 2) by configuring NewGen Business Process Management (BPM) workflows and integrating them with Oracle back ends over Representational State Transfer (REST) Application Programming Interfaces (APIs).

Decreased manual reporting effort by 50% across three industry verticals by building a Flask and Oracle analytics platform with real-time dashboards; reduced manual data reconciliation effort by about 35% for a financial services client with an Oracle automation solution.
Surfaced actionable insights for client decision-making by delivering exploratory data analysis (EDA), statistical modelling and dashboards in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib), Excel and SQL.

Reduced onboarding time for new team members by producing architecture diagrams, API reference guides, database data dictionaries and developer onboarding manuals; delivered work in Agile sprints with code reviews and Git branching.
Improved LLM accuracy and safety across software engineering, mathematics and science by providing data annotation, evaluation and prompt engineering.
Raised model accuracy on technical and STEM content by conducting linguistic, reasoning and fact-checking tasks, and supported conversational AI alignment with ethical AI standards.
Earned repeated project assignments by delivering top-tier quality outputs and ranking among high-performing contributors across evaluation cycles.
Increased response rates by 25% by using Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tools to track interactions, segment audiences and personalize outreach.
Achieved ±0.05 mm dimensional accuracy by modelling industrial components in AutoCAD and SolidWorks.
Validated structural integrity and improved product safety before manufacture by conducting Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and mechanical simulations.
Contributed to a 15% reduction in unplanned downtime by supporting preventive maintenance schedules and root-cause troubleshooting.
Enabled compliance audits and inter-departmental knowledge transfer by preparing detailed engineering reports and technical documentation.
Supported autonomous driving, computer vision and Natural Language Processing (NLP) models by labeling image, text and 3D data across diverse AI/ML projects.
Built training datasets at scale by specializing in autonomous driving Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) annotation, NLP dataset construction and structured data labeling.
Protected data integrity across client projects by conducting Quality Assurance (QA) and peer reviews.
Improved team throughput and annotation quality by training and mentoring new annotators.
